text:
maria: FYI saw a 3.8% token increase on yesterday's invoice preview after we rolled the route-priority changes.
kevin: any initial hypothesis? retries or extra fanout?
sam: raw events show pairs with same req_id but two meter rows: route-resolver emitted an audit event and runtime emitted the actual serve. both include tokens.
ellie: can you paste sanitized sample?
maria: here (sanitized):
```
{"req_id":"r-7b2","tenant":"t-42","model_id":"open-7b","tokens":18,"fingerprint":"fp-abc","served":true}
{"req_id":"r-7b2","tenant":"t-42","model_id":"open-7b-fallback","tokens":18,"fingerprint":"fp-abc","served":false,"source":"route-resolver","audit":true}
```
kevin: ah right. we added the fallback audit emit to the resolver to help debug latency but missed flagging it non-billable.
raj: ingestion should treat audit events as non-billable. but be careful: ensembles legitimately trigger multiple model serves.
tess: rule proposal: in streaming-ingest, drop events where source=="route-resolver" AND audit==true. keep all events from runtime.
sam: also a backfill: group by req_id,fingerprint,tenant and keep the row with served==true. but only if the other rows have model_id with suffix "-fallback" and served==false.
ellie: add guard: if tokens differ or model_ids are two distinct models (not simply suffix), do not dedupe.
kevin: I'll ship a hotfix filter to staging now. deploying in 8m.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled by kevin at 2026-03-24T09:08Z :rocket:
maria: after deploy, run invoice preview backfill for last 48h and compare deltas.
sam: I'll run the dedupe job as a dry-run first and produce a delta summary.
tess: longer-term: change route-resolver to emit only trace events (trace-only metadata) not full metering records; that avoids accidental billing leakage. I'll own the PR and tests.
raj: document action items in the incident doc: timeline, sample events, ingest rule, backfill query, and test plan.
kevin: hotfix PR opened: hotfix/ingest-filter-billing-2026-03-24. merging after staging smoke.
ops-bot: deploy completed by kevin at 2026-03-24T09:16Z :white_check_mark:
maria: staging preview shows delta fixed. finance-team: can you review prod invoice preview after backfill?
finance-team: ack, will review when you signal the backfill completion.
sam: backfill dry-run suggests we would remove ~1.2M duplicate token rows across 600 tenants. scheduling final backfill after 1h.
tess: added e2e asserting no metering rows have source==route-resolver and audit==true in upcoming release branch.
raj: good. add a dashboard card tracking route-resolver metering emits by tenant so we can spot regressions.
maria: thanks all. follow-up: postmortem write-up with impact and customer outreach plan.
